name_reason: Name is compliant and accurate: fd2_ prefix + render domain + clear descriptor. It renders the STATIC layout (layered dialog frame + portrait + 2 fixed UI sprites) of the character status panel, then delegates dynamic HP/MP/stat painting to fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel. 'static_layout' precisely captures the fixed-chrome role vs the dynamic stat panel. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Render the static chrome of the character status panel (layered dialog frame, portrait sprite, two fixed UI sprites) into a 0x140-stride overlay buffer, then call the stat-detail painter.
logic_summary: Sets data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset to the status-screen mode value 0xC88. Loads the character's portrait sprite from DATO.DAT (entry = runtime_char[char_idx].portrait_id) into data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buffer. Computes portrait_pixels = buffer + *buffer (first int is the offset to the sprite payload). Draws the layered dialog frame via fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered(overlay_buffer, 0x140, 5,7,5,5). Performs 3 normal blits at stride 0x140: portrait at overlay+0xC88, upper-left UI sprite (sheet + sheet_offset[0x56]) at overlay+0x91C, right-side UI sprite (sheet + sheet_offset[0x5A]) at overlay+0x7585. Finally calls fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel(char_idx, overlay_buffer) to fill HP/MP bars and numeric stats. Straight-line code (cyclomatic complexity 1).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; selects which runtime character's portrait/stats to render. Forwarded as-is to fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel. Callers (fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in, fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu, fd2_spell_selection_menu_main) pass their current character index.
params.reason: Accurate, descriptive, no address residue; matches the runtime_char array index role.

params.name: overlay_buffer
params.semantics: Linear address of the destination 0x140-stride (320px) compose surface. Callers pass an off-screen 64000-byte workspace (e.g. data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf_ptr), NOT the live 0xA0000 framebuffer; the panel is composed here and slid in afterward.
params.reason: Name correctly conveys it is the destination compose/overlay buffer; no address residue. Distinct from the live framebuffer, which the term 'overlay' appropriately signals.
